description: This file defines the 'DDataReader' interface which specifies methods for reading and monitoring distributed Bloom filters of subscribed topics within a distributed system using Akka. It includes methods for fetching subscribers, reading data from the local replicator, approximating topics, and managing change event subscriptions.

classes.name: DDataReader
classes.description: A generic interface for reading distributed Bloom filters of subscribed topics, providing methods for retrieving subscribers, reading distributed data, approximating topics, and managing change subscriptions.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Returns a future collection of ActorRef objects representing subscribers whose Bloom filter contains all hashes of specified topics.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a low-level map from the local replicator, with default version reading from local.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a low-level map from the local replicator with specified read consistency.

methods.name: approximate
methods.description: Maps a topic to its approximation in the distributed data.

methods.name: receiveChanges
methods.description: Starts sending distributed data change events to the specified recipient.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the distributed data used by this reader.
